analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA receptor negative allosteric modulators act at GABA-A receptors, which are barely expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional response should be weak; the most similar classes are other GABA receptor-targeting classes that share the same receptor system and would also produce little response.
